project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-153 One-Command Local Run (Compose Consolidation + Schema Lifecycle, Open-Core Capstone)
description:
Integration capstone of the open-core program, LAST in the stack: branch cut from ralph/prd-152-mem0-decoupling tip (worktree ../automatos-ai-prd153); PRD-150 (AUTH_PROVIDER=local), PRD-151 (MinIO storage factory), PRD-152 (mem0/internal-services local-safe defaults) are assumed DONE on the base. If they are only partially done, this PRD's smoke honestly FAILS — do NOT work around missing decoupling with shims, REQUIRE_AUTH hacks beyond what envs/api.defaults already encodes, or skipped checks. GOAL: from a clean checkout, `cp .env.example .env` (3 secrets + 1 LLM key) then ONE command `docker compose up --build` boots the whole platform with ZERO external SaaS (no Clerk, no AWS, no hosted mem0), and a smoke flow passes: local identity (unauthenticated request resolves a workspace), create a Task (POST /api/v1/tasks), get a chat/Auto response (POST /api/chat). METHOD: (0) hotfix the broken initdb mount + seed path; (1) one schema lifecycle — alembic single head, from-zero replay proven by test, then DELETE init_complete_schema.sql and orchestrator/core/database/migrations/ and move migrate+seed into one entrypoint shared with Railway; (2) one compose — fold infrastructure/docker-compose.{yml,core,data,memory,monitoring,voice}.yml into the root file as default services + profiles (observability/voice/optimizer/tools) and DELETE them, with project-name isolation (no container_name:, no fixed volume/network name:, all host ports env-parameterized); (3) env layering — compose env_file: wiring to the already-committed envs/*.defaults, .env.example rewritten to secrets-only, aggregated boot-time required-var validation; (4) scripts/compose-smoke.sh — the load-bearing artifact: boots an ISOLATED project (default -p automatos-smoke, ports 15432/16379/18000/13000/16333/19000/18765/15433) so it NEVER collides with the dev stack running on this machine, runs the golden checks, always cleans up only its own project; (5) CI smoke workflow + QUICKSTART rewrite. EVERY iteration: re-read docs/PRDS/PRD-153-ONE-COMMAND-LOCAL-RUN.md and CLAUDE.md; tip must stay green and stackable after every commit. ENV NOTE: the fresh worktree has no Python venv — prefer validating via docker (compose config, docker compose run/exec backend pytest ...); if host pytest is needed, create .venv from orchestrator/requirements.txt once and reuse. OUT OF SCOPE: Kubernetes/Helm, auth/storage/mem0 code changes (150/151/152 own them), landing-site containers (leave infrastructure/docker-compose.landing.yml in place), Railway config changes (railway.json, railway-manifest.json, per-service env — byte-untouched except the shared entrypoint), performance tuning, publishing/licensing, flipping CI required-checks, running migrations against ANY database other than the smoke project's own scratch postgres.

VERIFIER AMENDMENTS (BINDING — adversarial re-verification 2026-06-09; these OVERRIDE story text where they conflict):
1. envs/api.defaults + envs/frontend.defaults + envs/observability.defaults are UNTRACKED on main. The overnight orchestrator copies envs/ into this worktree; P153-S1's FIRST act is `git add envs/ && commit` so they become tracked on this branch (S5/S7/S8 and both compose gates depend on it).
2. LLM key for the smoke chat check: root .env keys are EMPTY; compose-smoke.sh must source ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY from orchestrator/.env (copied into the worktree by the orchestrator) or the ambient shell — never commit or print them.
3. S2 MUST create the worktree-root venv: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r orchestrator/requirements.txt (the guard-test gate uses .venv; bare host `python` has no pytest). All test invocations use python3 / .venv.
4. S12's dead-reference sweep grep MUST exclude its own scaffolding and history: add --exclude-dir=ralph, exempt the envs/observability.defaults provenance comment, and exempt orchestrator/alembic/versions/ historical docstrings (prd142_wave4_harness_store.py mentions init_complete_schema.sql and legitimately survives on the repair path).
5. S3: the post-squash single-root check is: test "$(grep -rl 'down_revision = None' orchestrator/alembic/versions | wc -l)" -eq 1. The from-zero integration test needs a pgvector-unavailable skip guard (CI postgres:15 ships no pgvector). If the repair path (not squash) wins, record that in the story's DONE note — the sweep exemption in (4) covers the surviving docstring.
6. S7 AC1 = five SEPARATE grep -q checks ANDed (a single alternation grep proves any-one, not all-five). S11 AC4's path-existence loop needs `|| exit 1` inside the body.
7. S9's dev-stack before/after untouched comparison runs ONLY if a dev stack is actually up (docker ps non-empty); otherwise skip with a note — Docker had 0 containers at planning time.
8. S5 AC1 (frontend present in the no-profile service set) is point-in-time — S8 later moves frontend behind the dev profile; do not transcribe S5's check into any final gate.
9. Additional owned files: S11 also fixes the stale boot-path/exec docs at docs/deployment-infrastructure/docker-compose-setup.md:~93, docs/deployment-infrastructure/_index.md:~81/~142, docs/overview/system-architecture.md:~187, docs/getting-started/_index.md:~133. S12 also DELETES the root Dockerfile.backend (verified zero references; it bakes the retired echo'd minimal entrypoint).
10. UNIVERSAL: 'grep -c ... returns 0' executes as '! grep -q ...'; commit-message ACs are discipline, not gates; every docker/compose invocation in smoke tooling is -p scoped and uses --wait-timeout; re-locate by content.

userStories.title: Phase-0 hotfix: fix initdb mount path, entrypoint seed path, gitignore envs/*.local
userStories.description: Three verified breakages, all one-liners. (1) docker-compose.yml line 35 mounts ./orchestrator/database/init_complete_schema.sql — that dir does NOT exist; the real file is orchestrator/core/database/init_complete_schema.sql. Fix the mount path. (2) docker-entrypoint.sh line 64 runs `python database/load_seed_data.py` from /app — orchestrator/database/ does not exist; the loader lives at core/database/load_seed_data.py. Fix to `python core/database/load_seed_data.py`. (3) .gitignore has no rule for envs/*.local (verified: `git check-ignore envs/api.local` exits 1) although envs/api.defaults documents that override layer — add `envs/*.local` under the env-files section. Do NOT restructure anything else yet; later stories delete the initdb mount entirely. Validate compose still renders with dummy secrets.

userStories.title: Alembic single head: guard test (RED) then merge heads (GREEN)
userStories.description: orchestrator/alembic/versions/ has 125 revisions with ~44 heads (verified; ~41 files have down_revision=None 'standalone — applied manually'). The Dockerfile CMDs use `alembic upgrade heads` (plural) to cope. TDD: create orchestrator/tests/test_alembic_lifecycle.py with test_single_head using alembic.script.ScriptDirectory (no DB needed): load alembic.ini config from the orchestrator dir, assert len(get_heads()) == 1. Run it — must FAIL first. Then `cd orchestrator && alembic merge heads -m "prd153 merge to single head"` (alembic heads listing is offline; if env.py demands env vars, export dummy POSTGRES_* — never point it at a real DB). Multiple ROOTS are fine at this stage; only heads must collapse to one. NOTE the stacked base may have added PRD-150/151/152 migrations — merge whatever heads exist on THIS branch. Do not touch Dockerfile CMDs yet (S4 owns the boot path). For host pytest, bootstrap a venv from orchestrator/requirements.txt (alembic+pytest are in it) or run via docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend.
acceptanceCriteria: cd orchestrator && python -m pytest tests/test_alembic_lifecycle.py::test_single_head -q passes (was demonstrably red before the merge revision — note the red run in the commit message)

userStories.title: Alembic-from-zero replay green: repair, or squash to a verified base (Q1 policy)
userStories.description: Prove empty DB → `alembic upgrade head` → table parity with SQLAlchemy metadata. TDD: extend orchestrator/tests/test_alembic_lifecycle.py with test_upgrade_from_zero (mark @pytest.mark.integration): connect to the Postgres from env (get_database_url, same resolver as conftest.py), CREATE DATABASE alembic_zero_<rand> via autocommit admin connection, run alembic upgrade head against it programmatically (alembic.command.upgrade with sqlalchemy.url override), then assert set(information_schema tables) ⊇ set(Base.metadata.tables) where models are imported exactly like orchestrator/scripts/init_test_db.py does (core.models * PLUS modules.memory.models — env.py currently imports only core.models Base; fix env.py to import the same set so autogenerate/parity see memory tables). Drop the scratch DB in teardown. EXPECT RED: ~41 disconnected down_revision=None roots ALTER tables whose CREATEs they race. POLICY (pre-agreed): attempt at most 3 targeted revision repairs; if still red, SQUASH — delete ALL files in orchestrator/alembic/versions/ and generate ONE base revision id `prd153_base` whose upgrade() starts with CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"/vector/pg_trgm (mirroring init_complete_schema.sql lines 10-12) then creates the full schema (autogenerate against an empty scratch DB, or Base.metadata.create_all(op.get_bind()) if autogenerate output is broken — parity test is the arbiter either way). Port any raw-SQL triggers/functions the old revisions created if the parity test or grep of deleted revisions shows them (e.g. composio usage trigger). test_single_head must stay green. NEVER run alembic against the dev stack DB or any non-scratch DB. Squash consequence for Railway (alembic stamp) is human-gated — record it in the commit message.
acceptanceCriteria: cd orchestrator && python -m pytest tests/test_alembic_lifecycle.py -q -m integration passes against a live Postgres (DATABASE_URL/POSTGRES_* from env; dev stack service or scratch container)
cd orchestrator && python -m pytest tests/test_alembic_lifecycle.py::test_single_head -q still passes

If squashed: ls orchestrator/alembic/versions/*.py | wc -l is small (1-3: base + any PRD-150/152 revisions deliberately re-chained) and grep -L 'down_revision' finds no orphan roots; commit message documents repair-vs-squash verdict and the Railway stamp requirement

userStories.title: Retire init SQL + raw migrations; one entrypoint owns wait→migrate→seed→start; seed required-green
userStories.description: Delete the two parallel schema mechanisms now that S3's replay is CI-green. (1) MOVE docker-entrypoint.sh → orchestrator/docker-entrypoint.sh (build context is ./orchestrator so it can be COPY'd); rewrite: wait_for_postgres → `alembic upgrade head` (singular) → seed → exec "$@". Seed step becomes required-green: remove the 'will continue anyway' warn path — failed seed exits non-zero and kills boot. (2) orchestrator/Dockerfile: COPY the real entrypoint instead of the echo'd minimal one (both stages), and strip `alembic upgrade heads && ` from BOTH CMDs (lines ~90 and ~140) so migration lives only in the entrypoint (shared compose/Railway boot contract — FR-7: nothing else in the Dockerfile changes). (3) docker-compose.yml: delete the initdb SQL mount AND the ./docker-entrypoint.sh bind-mount (now baked; the ./orchestrator:/app dev mount does not hide /usr/local/bin). (4) DELETE orchestrator/core/database/init_complete_schema.sql and the whole orchestrator/core/database/migrations/ dir (9 SQL + README) — audit each script first: post-squash the parity test proves representation; record per-file verdict (represented/dead) in the commit message. (5) DELETE orchestrator/core/database/init_database.py (verified orphan: main.py imports init_database from core/database/database.py, not this file; it also references the nonexistent orchestrator/database/ path). (6) orchestrator/core/database/load_seed_data.py: return False if ANY sub-step fails (today system-settings/models/skills/personas/plugin-categories swallow exceptions and it still prints SUCCESS); keep idempotency (ON CONFLICT paths exist). Seed must leave config._required_int_setting keys present (seeds/seed_system_settings.py) or chat 500s later.

(2) .claude/hooks/block-secrets.sh: add a narrow allow for *.example BEFORE the block patterns (pre-approved openQuestion; touch nothing else in the hook). userStories.title: scripts/compose-smoke.sh: isolated one-command boot + golden-path checks (login/identity, Task, chat)
userStories.description: THE capstone artifact; the acceptance gate and CI both run it. NEW scripts/compose-smoke.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail). Defaults (overridable via env): SMOKE_PROJECT=automatos-smoke, COMPOSE_PROFILES=dev,memory (drop memory automatically if ../automatos-mem0 is absent AND mem0-server still needs the sibling build context), ports POSTGRES 15432, REDIS 16379, API 18000, FRONTEND 13000, QDRANT 16333/16334, MINIO 19000/19001, MEM0 18765, MEM0_PG 15433 — never the dev-stack defaults. Behavior: (1) generate a throwaway env file via mktemp (NEVER committed, NEVER named *.env in-repo): random secrets via openssl rand -hex, the port set, COMPOSE_PROFILES; pass LLM keys through from caller env, else parse ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY out of the main checkout's root .env if readable; (2) `docker compose -p $SMOKE_PROJECT --env-file $TMP up -d --build --wait` (every docker compose invocation carries -p and --env-file; NOTHING in the script may touch other projects — no bare down, no prune); (3) checks, each with retries/timeouts and loud failure: GET :18000/health → 200; GET :13000/ → 200; identity: GET :18000/api/v1/tasks with NO Clerk headers → 200 JSON (PRD-150 local identity; adapt to the actual PRD-150 surface found on the branch — the invariant is zero Clerk vars anywhere); create Task: POST :18000/api/v1/tasks {"title":"PRD-153 smoke"} → 2xx with id; chat: POST :18000/api/chat {"message":{"content":"Reply with the word pong"}} → 200 and non-empty streamed text within 120s (REQUIRED when an LLM key is present; hard-fail with a clear message if no key — gate supplies one); in-container: `exec -T backend alembic heads | grep -c '(head)'` == 1, `exec -T backend alembic current` shows head, `exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d orchestrator_db -tc 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credential_types'` > 0 (seed green); service health: qdrant :16333/healthz, minio :19000/minio/health/live, workspace-worker via `exec -T workspace-worker curl -fsS localhost:8081/health`, mem0 :18765/health when memory profile on; isolation proof: `docker compose -p $SMOKE_PROJECT --env-file $TMP config | grep -c container_name:` == 0; (4) flags: --config-only (render config -q for default and for observability/voice/optimizer/tools/prod profile combos with the generated env, no boot), --keep (skip teardown), --full (additionally: doc upload + RAG answer [PRD-151], L3 store/recall [PRD-152] — best-effort extension, not gate-blocking); (5) trap EXIT → `docker compose -p $SMOKE_PROJECT --env-file $TMP down -v` + rm tempfile. First full boot WILL surface integration bugs from S2–S8 (entrypoint, seed strictness, depends_on) — fixing those here is in scope; keep fixes minimal and re-run until green.
